description: Fixed `smithy-rpc-v2-cbor` event stream output: event, initial-response and exception payloads are now decoded as CBOR against the model, initial-response members are now set on the result, and requests now send `Accept: application/vnd.amazon.eventstream`. Also fixed event stream decoding for all protocols: an empty non-seekable stream no longer throws, a whole-second timestamp header no longer decodes to `false`, a string `@eventPayload` member no longer throws, and signed header minimums decode correctly.
